acceptance.procedure: Supported claim cites distinct valid choices.
Revision names the new contradicting choice, preserves prior claim, and changes interpretation.
Contrasts +40/-40/+40/-40 at weight 100 never qualify; no opposing example is support.
Three unfamiliar-song skips yield skip_bound and honest insufficient evidence, not broad taste.
Strong priors with zero observed choices cannot supply supporting evidence.
Repeat same mutation after timeout: one committed vote/vector change and identical feedback; conflicting content returns 409.
Large scale contrast is excluded when only tension is declared.
Missing declared values stay unknown, not zero/50; no supporting claim.
Preserve repeated-artist alternative explanation; helper eligibility alone is not confound acceptance.
Harder changes effective selection inputs at low lane confidence without mutating vector.
No eligible replacement yields no_alternative, retains presentation and scores.
Three skips after three answers stop; an intervening answer resets the streak across resume.
Empty eligible pool returns catalog_exhausted, not budget/confident; both clients frame it honestly.
Generator failure returns deterministic evidence-bounded fallback without losing votes or rerolling saved results.
Reject invented songs and disallowed claims and return cached deterministic fallback.
Terminate after server commit; restore same revision, presentation, chronological exchanges and pending mutation result.
Same presentation yields one accepted mutation and replay/conflict; different concurrent choices cannot lose updates.
Unpublished token is unavailable and reveals no private/session/vector/chat data.
Publish explicitly, open frozen result, revoke, delete; old links become neutrally unavailable with coherent caches.
Recipient gets same IDs/order/revisions, independent ownership/evidence and no sender choices before voting.
Self-report creates a new version; pairing vector and original/public result remain unchanged.
